purpose: Give an operator a compact, machine-readable view of a long-running stage without opening logs or inspecting scientific outputs.
cardinal_rule: The status document is OBSERVATIONAL ONLY. No code may read it to decide what to do next. Control flow is driven exclusively by the hash-chain ledger and the stage receipts. A status document that influences scientific behavior is a defect.
additional_rules: The status document must never contain a target value, a prediction, a metric, an RVE score, or any other scientific outcome.
It may contain counts, identifiers, timings, byte totals, error counts, and blocker codes.
It is written atomically: write to <name>.tmp then rename, so a reader never sees a partial document.
It is rewritten in full on every update; it is not appended to.
Losing or deleting the status document must never affect resume, validation, or results.
Update cadence is at least once per completed unit and at least once every 60 seconds while running.
No status field may influence science except through the prospectively frozen time and resource gates (the launch gate and the drop ladder).
III_A_STATUS is never a function of III_B_STATUS. A III-B blocker or CLEAN_SKIP must not alter any III-A field.
III_B_STATUS = CLEAN_SKIP is an honourable pre-registered outcome and must not be rendered as an error state.
HOURS_TO_ABSOLUTE_DEADLINE is advisory for operators; only the launch gate and drop ladder may act on time, and only through their frozen rules.

Free-space fields are BYTES and are pool-qualified. Two logical categories that resolve to the same device id are ONE pool and are reported once; POOL_DURABLE_FREE_BYTES is null whenever POOL_DURABLE is not a distinct local filesystem.
III_B_STATUS = CLEAN_SKIP may be the modal schedule outcome. It is a pre-registered honourable result and is never rendered as an error, a warning, or a degraded state.

PROCESS_ALIVE.description: True while the owning process holds the status file lock and has updated within the staleness window.

STAGE.description: The lifecycle state this process is executing.

STAGE_STATUS.description: Coarse stage state. BLOCKED means CURRENT_BLOCKER is set.

TOTAL_UNITS.description: Planned unit count for this stage, from the frozen plan.

COMPLETED_UNITS.description: Units at the stage's terminal state.

CURRENT_UNIT.description: Identifier of the in-flight unit, for example e3_t07__L2 or e3_t07__L2/layer_19/CURRENT.

LAST_COMPLETED_UNIT.description: Identifier of the most recently completed unit.

ELAPSED_TIME.description: Wall-clock seconds since this stage process started.

LAST_MESSAGE_AT.description: Timestamp of the last status update.

LAST_MESSAGE.description: Short human-readable note. Never a scientific value.

ERRORS_SEEN.description: Count of unit-level errors encountered in this process lifetime.

CURRENT_BLOCKER.description: A code from BLOCKER_TAXONOMY.json, or null. Any non-null value must be a valid taxonomy code.

RETRY_COUNT.description: Retries attempted for CURRENT_UNIT under the same frozen spec.

POST_STAGE_VALIDATOR_STATUS.description: State of the validator that gates this stage's exit.

NEXT_STAGE.description: The next authorized lifecycle state, from EXPERIMENT_III_LIFECYCLE.json.

PROGRAM_STAGE.description: Which part of the program this process is advancing.

III_A_STATUS.description: III-A module state. Never influenced by III-B.

III_B_STATUS.description: III-B module state. CLEAN_SKIP is an honourable pre-registered outcome.

VALID_UNITS.description: Units that passed their per-unit validation.

INVALID_UNITS.description: Units that failed validation and were not superseded by a valid retry.

DURABLE_UNITS.description: Units published and read back by hash from the durable store.

BYTES_WRITTEN.description: Bytes written by this stage so far.

EXPECTED_BYTES.description: Frozen expected byte total for this stage.

ESTIMATED_TIME_REMAINING.description: Naive projection from COMPLETED_UNITS and ELAPSED_TIME. Advisory only; never a control input.

FREE_DISK_BYTES.description: Free bytes on POOL_WORKING, the filesystem holding data/experiment_iii/. Always bytes; never decimal GB, never binary GiB, in this field.

POOL_WORKING_DEVICE_ID.description: Device/volume id of POOL_WORKING, as recorded by A3.

POOL_DURABLE_MODE.description: Durability mode recorded at A3. Determines whether POOL_DURABLE_FREE_BYTES is meaningful.

POOL_DURABLE_FREE_BYTES.description: Free bytes on POOL_DURABLE when it is a DISTINCT local filesystem; null when the mode is LOCAL_MIRROR_SAME_POOL (the value would duplicate FREE_DISK_BYTES) or REMOTE_OBJECT_STORE (no meaningful local bound).

POOL_SCRATCH_IS_DISTINCT_POOL.description: True only when the scratch path resolves to a different device/volume id than POOL_WORKING, proven at A3.

AUTHORITY_SHA256.description: The authority this process is bound to.

SOURCE_CLOSURE.description: The source closure digest this process is running.

P2_FREEZE_SHA256.description: The freeze package this process is bound to, where applicable.

CURRENT_CONDITION_BATCH.description: A7 only: the condition batch in progress, for example block=2 period=4 condition=L1.

III_B_GATE_STATUS.description: Launch-gate verdict. Derived from time, technical state and resources only.

III_B_GATE_NEXT_EVALUATION.description: 2026-09-02T12:00 local, then once at 17:00. Null after the final verdict.

III_B_SELECTED_Q_SET.description: The q levels actually in scope, e.g. [0.0125, 0.05, 0.2] or [0.05, 0.2] at drop LEVEL_1.

III_B_COMPLETED_TRIPLES.description: Identities with all in-scope q cells complete.

III_B_REQUIRED_TRIPLES.description: Triples required by the selected drop level.

III_B_BLOCKER.description: A B_* code from BLOCKER_TAXONOMY.json, or null.

III_B_DROP_LEVEL.description: Selected from time, technical completion and resources ONLY.

HOURS_TO_ABSOLUTE_DEADLINE.description: Hours until 2026-09-03T20:00 local, computed from authority-controlled time. May go negative.

PHASE2_START.description: The instant Phase 2 was authorized and the authority frozen. Advisory; the absolute deadline and the derived checkpoints do not move with it.

SELECTED_DEADLINE_PLAN.description: Frozen plan currently selected. Escalates monotonically. Derived from time, implementation completion, technical state and resources ONLY.

NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKPOINT.description: Next instant from deadline_fallbacks.implementation_checkpoints, or null once all have been evaluated.

example.LAST_MESSAGE: capture running; wall receipt clean; sentinel pre-batch PASS
